cars.variant: Mercedes-AMG C63 S saloon — June 2015 UK seven-speed MCT reference
cars.specification_market: 2015 UK Mercedes-AMG C63 S saloon, original seven-speed AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT automatic and standard equipment in the factory guide effective 1 June 2015. Count the W205/S205/C205/A205 performance-road family once across C63/C63 S, saloon/estate/coupe/cabriolet, editions and facelift. Not earlier W204 naturally aspirated C63, ordinary AMG Line trim, C43 4MATIC or later W206 hybrid. UK 375-kW output is retained without relabeling the brochure’s 510-hp convention as US SAE hp. The US road test’s dual-clutch specification-panel label is not adopted; factory MCT designation controls. No US optional ceramic brakes, later nine-speed MCT, test times, mass or prices imported.
cars.summary: The W205 C63 carried AMG’s muscular compact sports-saloon tradition into the biturbo-V8 era. The contemporary instrumented road test documents a major handling improvement alongside its strong V8 character, while acknowledging firm ride and imperfect transmission engagement. The C63 S saloon represents the generation once across bodies, outputs, editions and facelift changes.

sources.title: C-Class Saloon and Estate — UK range guide effective 1 June 2015
sources.source_type: Original manufacturer UK sales/specification guide, hosted scan
sources.notes: 88-page PDF, 8,590,684 bytes. PDF indexes 0 (cover/date), 48 (printed 49, S equipment), 49 (50, standard-equipment matrix), 52 (53, additional standard equipment), 69–73 (70–74, saloon technical tables, footnotes and general-body diagram) individually visually read. Index 75 estate table was inspected for navigation but is not selected saloon data. Other rendered pages are not claimed as audited. Braced values are C63 S; base 350 kW/650 Nm/18-inch data are not substituted. Factory seven-speed MCT label controls rather than US review’s dual-clutch panel. No optional B07 ceramics or forged/black wheel package inferred from photo. The general-body diagram is not treated as AMG-specific dimensions. Footnote 3 confirms the listed maximum speed is electronically limited.

sources.title: The New Black: 2015 Mercedes-AMG C63 S Tested — K.C. Colwell, 7 August 2015
sources.notes: Relevant full road-test body and specification panel read. Admission and limitations only: handling and V8 character alongside ride and transmission-engagement faults. Panel says dual-clutch, while factory guide identifies AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT; panel label not copied. Tested US optional carbon-ceramic front brakes, driver-assistance equipment, power units and measured performance are not UK standard specification.
